description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the language every web page is written in. It describes the structure of a page: which text is a heading, which is a paragraph, where the links, images, lists, tables and forms go. Browsers read HTML and turn it into the page you see; screen readers and search engines read the same HTML to understand what the page means. This tutorial takes you from your very first page to semantic, accessible, search-friendly documents, with runnable examples and a rendered preview after every one.
versionNote: Covers the HTML Living Standard as implemented by current browsers (2026). There is no 'HTML 6'; what people call HTML5 is simply modern HTML.
whatYouWillLearn: Write a valid HTML document from scratch and open it in a browser
Use headings, paragraphs, lists, links, images and tables correctly
Build accessible forms with the right input types and validation attributes
Structure pages with semantic elements that screen readers and search engines understand
Embed audio and video and use the HTML APIs that connect markup to JavaScript
Apply the on-page SEO basics that depend on HTML
learningObjectives: Explain the difference between tags, elements and attributes
Choose the right element for a piece of content instead of styling a generic div
Read and fix invalid markup using the browser's developer tools
Create forms that collect and validate data without JavaScript
Describe how semantic HTML improves accessibility and search ranking

seo.title: HTML Tutorial – Learn HTML Step by Step
seo.description: Free HTML tutorial for beginners: elements, attributes, links, images, tables, forms, semantic HTML, media and SEO, with runnable examples and quizzes.
